HooksFeature (builtin.hooks) exposes pre- and post-operation hooks over REST and the CLI, merging hooks defined in praisonaiagents.hooks (SDK hooks) with hooks registered dynamically through the API.

Method Path Description GET /api/hooks List all merged SDK and UI-registered hooks POST /api/hooks Register a new hook (name, event, type: "pre" \ "post", enabled) GET /api/hooks/{hook_id} Fetch a UI-registered hook DELETE /api/hooks/{hook_id} Delete a UI-registered hook POST /api/hooks/{hook_id}/trigger Trigger a hook manually with optional {"data": {...}} payload GET /api/hooks/log View recent hook executions (?limit=50)
